Name: threshold
Description: Segmentation score lesser than this threshold would be rejected

Name: num_segmentation_classes
Description: Number of output classes for the segmentation network

Name: custom_parse_segmentation_func
Description: Name of the custom segmentation output parsing function. If not specified, Gst-nvinferserver uses the internal function for the UNet model provided by the SDK. If specified, users also need to set custom_lib to load custom library.
